name: Jobma
summary: Jobma runs one-way and live video interviews, with self-service interview booking and scorecards for reviewers. Its pricing page names no plans or prices and says custom packages depend on volume, integrations and feature needs.

facts.text: The homepage describes structured, on-demand video interviews that candidates complete on their own schedule.
The homepage describes structured live interviews with hiring managers and panelists, and says evaluations are shared in real time.
The homepage says interview scheduling includes self-service booking, calendar sync and automated reminders.
The homepage says reviewers rate against the same scorecard and leave comments on specific answers.

plans.name: Custom package
plans.notes: The FAQ says custom packages are based on volume, integrations and feature needs. No prices are listed.

hiddenCosts: The pricing page lists no plan names, prices or minimums.
